title: a goes with u, b goes with v

text.guided: You used the right two numbers, but on the wrong thrusters: the first coefficient multiplies the **first** vector and the second multiplies the second. Rebuild the position in your head: a copies of u, then b copies of v.
text.fast: Order matters: a multiplies u, b multiplies v.

scene.caption: 2u + 1v = (3, 1) but 1u + 2v = (3, 2): swapping the coefficients moves the drone
